desc:
In 2011, NASA sent five astronauts on an expedition to Jupiter to investigate mysterious lifeforms known as the Kies.

THE FIVE ASTRONAUTS:
- Mateo O.Algo
- Kreek
- Watkins Jr.
- Case
- Joe Bart

What happened during the mission became known as The Jupiter Incident.

🔫 Fight the Kies, earn Keys, and unlock new weapons!

📼 Find all 7 Lost Tapes to uncover the story and unlock Case!

🪐 Explore the moon, survive the Kies, and uncover the secrets of the 2011 expedition.

👍 LIKE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES!

🚧 Currently in Development — New content coming soon!
